Rashi on Yevamot 37b:12:1.hebrew: ממון המוטל בספק - שאין זה מוחזק בזה יותר מזה, דאם זה בן המת, אין ליבם בהן כלום, ואם בן היבם הוא, אין לו בהן כלום. הלכך, אין כאן מוציא מחברו להטיל עליו הראיה:
Rashi on Yevamot 37b:12:1.english: Property of uncertain ownership - For neither one is in possession of this [property] any more than the other, since if this [child] is the son of the deceased, the yavam has nothing in them at all, and if he is the son of the yavam, [the child] has nothing in them at all. Therefore, there is no [party] exacting [property] from his fellow upon whom to place [the burden of] proof.

Rashi on Yevamot 37b:13:1.hebrew: ספק ובני יבם - הספק מוחזק בהן ביותר, דממה נפשך אית ליה זכיה בגווייהו, אבל בני יבם, שמא אין להם חלק בהם, שזה בן ראשון הוא וכולה שלו. ומשום הכי סבור רבנן למימר: היינו מתניתין בפ' נושאין על האנוסה, דקתני: ספק בן תשעה לראשון ספק בן שבעה לאחרון — הוא לא יורש אותן, לא זה ולא זה, דבני ראשון מדחו ליה אצל בני אחרון ובני אחרון אצל בני ראשון, והם יורשים אותו בין שניהם:
Rashi on Yevamot 37b:13:1.english: [One of] uncertain [descent] and the sons of the yavam - The [one of] uncertain [descent] has a stronger presumptive claim to them, for either way he has a right in them, whereas the sons of the yavam — perhaps they have no share in them, for [perhaps] this one is the son of the first [husband] and all of it is his. And because of this, the Rabbis thought to say: this is [the same as] the Mishnah in the chapter [entitled] Nos'in al Ha'anusah, which teaches: [Regarding one who is] possibly a nine-month [child] of the first [husband and] possibly a seven-month [child] of the latter [husband] — he does not inherit them, neither this one nor that one, for the sons of the first [husband] push him off to the sons of the latter [husband], and the sons of the latter [husband push him off] to the sons of the first [husband], and they inherit him between the two of them.

Rashi on Yevamot 37b:15:1.hebrew: והכא אמרינן איפכא - דהוא מוחזק יותר; דהתם להכי מדחו ליה, דאמרי ליה: "אייתי ראיה דאחונא את ושקול", והכא נמי אמר להו האי: "אייתו ראיה דאחוכון אנא ושקולו":
Rashi on Yevamot 37b:15:1.english: And here we say the reverse - For he is more firmly in possession; for there, that is why they push him off, as they say to him, "Bring proof that you are our brother and take [a share]," and here too, this one says to them, "Bring proof that I am your brother and take [a share]."

Rashi on Yevamot 37b:17:1.english: Is [it] comparable? There, they [have a] definite [claim] - For they know by virtue of whom they are coming to inherit.

Rashi on Yevamot 37b:17:2.hebrew: אידי ואידי ספיקא נינהו - שאפילו הספק אין טוען טענת ודאי, ואינו יודע מכח מי הוא בא לירש:
Rashi on Yevamot 37b:17:2.english: Both this one and that one are uncertain - For even the [son of] uncertain [descent] does not advance a definite claim, and he does not know by virtue of whom he comes to inherit.

Rashi on Yevamot 37b:18:1.hebrew: בנכסי יבם גופיה - התם מיתוקמא מתניתין, דהוא לא יורש אותן, דאמרי ליה אייתי ראיה ושקול, אבל בההיא דלעיל, שניהם ספק. ונראה בעיני דההיא מנתא דקמודו ליה שקיל, ואידך הוי ממון המוטל בספק וחולקין — הוא נוטל החצי ובין כולן החצי:
Rashi on Yevamot 37b:18:1.english: In the possessions of the yavam himself - There [the case of] the Mishnah is established, for he does not inherit them, since they say to him, "Bring proof and take [your share]"; however, in that [case] above, both of them are uncertain. And it seems to me that that portion which they concede to him, he takes, and the rest is money whose [ownership] lies in doubt, and they divide [it] — he takes half, and among all of them [they take] half.

Rashi on Yevamot 37b:19:1.hebrew: לבתר דפלג יבם - עם ספק בנכסי מיתנא, כדאמרן לעיל דחולקין:
Rashi on Yevamot 37b:19:1.english: After the yavam divided - with the [son of] uncertain [descent] in the possessions of the deceased [brother], as we said above, that they divide [them].

Rashi on Yevamot 37b:1:1.hebrew: הלכתא אהלכתא - דקיימא לן משנת ר"א ב"י קב ונקי, במסכת גיטין (דף סז.):
Rashi on Yevamot 37b:1:1.english: Halakha upon halakha - For we hold [that] the teaching of Rabbi Eliezer ben Ya'akov is [a] kav and clean [i.e., concise and authoritative], in Tractate Gittin (67a).

Rashi on Yevamot 37b:20:1.hebrew: אי אחוכון אנא הבו לי מנתא גבייכו - ואי משום דשקלי אנא פלגא בנכסי מיתנא, מהדרנא לכו ההוא פלגא, ונחלוק הכל בשוה — בין נכסי הראשון בין נכסי האחרון. וכגון שהיו נכסי היבם מרובין ואביו מועטין:
Rashi on Yevamot 37b:20:1.english: If I am your brother, give me a portion with you - And if [you object] because I [already] took half of the deceased's property, I will return that half to you, and we will divide everything equally — both the property of the first [brother] and the property of the last [brother]. And [this applies in a case] such as where the yavam's property was abundant and his father's [i.e., the deceased's, was] small.

Rashi on Yevamot 37b:21:1.hebrew: קם דינא - אחר שנעשה דין בנכסי המת, אין זה יכול לחזור ולערער עליהם. ומה שהוא שואל בנכסי היבם, אמרי ליה: אייתי ראיה:
Rashi on Yevamot 37b:21:1.english: The verdict stands - After judgment has been rendered regarding the property of the deceased, this [son] cannot go back and contest it. And [regarding] what he claims in the property of the yavam, they say to him: "Bring proof."

Rashi on Yevamot 37b:21:2.hebrew: הדר דינא - ומהדרי ליה פלגא דנכסי מיתנא, או פלג כולהו נכסי בשוה:
Rashi on Yevamot 37b:21:2.english: The verdict is reconsidered - And they return to him half of the deceased's possessions, or [they] divide all the possessions equally.

Rashi on Yevamot 37b:22:1.hebrew: ואבדה דרך שדהו - שהיתה שדהו מוקפת משדות אחרים, והיה לו דרך על אחת מן הרוחות, ואבדה, ששכחו על איזה מן הרוחות היתה:
Rashi on Yevamot 37b:22:1.english: And the path to his field was lost - For his field was surrounded by the fields of others, and he had a path on one of the sides, and it was lost, for they forgot on which of the sides it was.

Rashi on Yevamot 37b:22:2.hebrew: ילך בקצרה - יתנו ביניהם דרך קצרה, ולקמן מפרש לה:
Rashi on Yevamot 37b:22:2.english: He may go on the shortest [path] - They grant [him] a short path among themselves, and later [the Gemara] explains it.

Rashi on Yevamot 37b:23:1.hebrew: שפיר קאמר אדמון - דקסלקא דעתא שהקיפו אדם אחד מכל רוחותיו, דאמר אורחיה גביה הוא:
Rashi on Yevamot 37b:23:1.english: Admon is saying well - For it was initially assumed that one person surrounded him on all his sides, so that he says [that] his path is with him.

Rashi on Yevamot 37b:23:2.english: Four people - For each and every one deflects him.

Rashi on Yevamot 37b:25:1.english: Who came on the basis of four - That four people sold them [the fields] to these [owners].

Rashi on Yevamot 37b:25:2.english: If you are silent, you are silent - And I will not raise [the price] for you to an exorbitant sum.

Rashi on Yevamot 37b:3:2.english: And the entire world becomes filled with mamzerim - Out of uncertainty, they are called mamzerim.

Rashi on Yevamot 37b:4:1.english: What is this - An expression of doubt.

Rashi on Yevamot 37b:5:1.hebrew: יתר על כן - דאפי' הכא, דע"י נישואין הוה והדבר מפורסם, גזר ר"א בן יעקב:
Rashi on Yevamot 37b:5:1.english: Furthermore - For even here, where it is through marriage and the matter is publicized, Rabbi Eliezer ben Yaakov decreed [against it].

Rashi on Yevamot 37b:6:1.english: Who will be [my wife] for [the] days - Who wishes to be married for the days that I will stay here.

Rashi on Yevamot 37b:7:1.hebrew: דפקיעי - כ"ע בשמייהו, וקוראין לבתו על שמו, ואם יבא בנו ממקום אחר, ישמע שהיא בת אביו ויפרוש:
Rashi on Yevamot 37b:7:1.english: That [their names] are renowned - Everyone [is familiar] with their names, and they call his daughter by his name; and if his son comes from another place, he will hear that she is his father's daughter and will refrain [from marrying her].

Rashi on Yevamot 37b:8:1.english: Seven clean [days] - Lest out of desire she menstruated at the time she consented.

Rashi on Yevamot 37b:9:1.english: They would send their messengers - Seven days before their arrival.

Tosafot on Yevamot 37b:12:1.hebrew: וממון המוטל בספק חולקים - אפילו רבנן דסומכוס (ב"ק לה:) מודו הכא, דלא שייך כאן "המוציא מחבירו עליו הראיה", שאין זה מוחזק יותר מזה; והוי כמו "הללו באין לירש והללו באין לירש", דאמר במי שמת (ב"ב דף קנח:) דיחלוקו:
Tosafot on Yevamot 37b:12:1.english: "And property of uncertain ownership, they divide" - Even the Rabbis [who dispute] Sumkhos (Bava Kamma 35b) agree here, for [the principle of] "the burden of proof is upon the one who seeks to exact [property] from his fellow" does not apply here, since neither one is in possession more than the other. And it is like [the case where] "these come to inherit and those come to inherit," where [the Gemara] says in [the chapter] Mi Shemet (Bava Batra 158b) that they divide [it].

Tosafot on Yevamot 37b:21:1.hebrew: אמר רבי אבא קם דינא - דוקא בתר דפלג, אבל מקמי דפלג לא:
Tosafot on Yevamot 37b:21:1.english: Rabbi Abba said: The verdict stands - Specifically after they divided [the property], but before they divided [it], [the verdict does] not [stand].

Tosafot on Yevamot 37b:25:1.hebrew: דאמר ליה אי שתקת שתקת - פי': "ולא תטול כלום", ולא כמו שפירש בקונט': "אי שתקת ומוזילנא לך", דהא קתני: "יקח לו דרך במאה מנה"! ובפ"ק דב"ק (דף ח.) גבי "מכרן לאחד כולן נכנסו תחת הבעלים", והויא אשה בזיבורית אע"פ שלקח עידית באחרונה, משום "אי שתקת כו'", ולא מצי אמרה ליה "לכי תהדר", כיון שאין בא להפקיע מדינא. ובחד דאתי מכח חד, לא מצי למימר "ואי לא, מזבנינא לארבעה", דהא פשיטא כיון דלא אתי מכח ארבעה — לא שבקינן ליה. ואם תאמר: וארבעה דאתו מכח חד — ליהדר ההוא חד דמי קצרה! וי"ל: דמצי אמר ליה "לא מכרתי אלא מה שיש לי בה":
Tosafot on Yevamot 37b:25:1.english: That he says to him: "If you are silent, you are silent" - Explanation: "and you will take nothing," and not as [Rashi] explained in the Kuntres: "If you are silent, I will lower [the price] for you," for [the Mishnah] teaches: "he must purchase for himself a path for one hundred maneh"! And in the first chapter of Bava Kamma (8a), regarding [the case where] "he sold them to one [buyer], all of them stand in place of the original owner," and the woman [collects her ketubah] from the inferior land even though he bought the superior land last, because of "if you are silent, etc.," and she cannot say to him: "When you return [the deed, we will deal with it]," since he is not coming to subvert the law. And in [the case of] one [owner] who comes by the power of [i.e., purchased from] one [previous owner], he cannot say: "And if not, I will sell [the fields] to four [people]," for it is obvious that since he does not come by the power of four [previous owners], we do not allow him [to do so]. And if you will say: And [in the case of] four [current owners] who come by the power of one [previous owner], let that one [previous owner] return the value of the shortest [path]! One can answer that he can say to him: "I only sold what I had in it."

Tosafot on Yevamot 37b:9:1.hebrew: יחודי בעלמא הוו מיחדי - ויש כאן פת בסלו, כיון שאם היה רוצה היה בא עליה; וכיון שפעמים לא היה בא עליה, לא מיחמדא ולא חזיא. דאי לא תימא הכי, גם להתיחד הוה אסור, כדאמר בפ"ק דכתובות (דף ד. ושם) גבי חתן: אם פרסה אשתו נדה — הוא ישן בין האנשים ואשתו ישנה בין הנשים. ומשום נושא אשה במדינה אחרת נמי ליכא למיחש, שאם היה אירע שבא עליה ונתעברה ממנו — היה מוליכה עמו לעירו:
Tosafot on Yevamot 37b:9:1.english: They were merely in seclusion [with them] - and there is [still the principle of] "bread in his basket" here, since if he wanted, he could have intercourse with her; and since sometimes he would not have intercourse with her, she does not feel desire and does not see [menstrual blood]. For if you do not say so, even to be in seclusion would be forbidden, as [the Gemara] states in the first chapter of Ketubot (4a, and there [in Tosafot]) regarding a groom: if his wife begins to menstruate, he sleeps among the men and his wife sleeps among the women. And regarding [the concern of] marrying a woman in another province, there is also nothing to be concerned about, for if it had happened that he had intercourse with her and she conceived from him, he would bring her with him to his city.
